ultima_cluster

An Aeron-shaped, Rust-native State Machine Replication application server. API documentation, generated from main.

Repository Quickstart Architecture Verification

Start here

  • uc2_service — the crate you write against. Implement StateMachine and attach it to a node.
  • uc2_client — submit commands, run linearizable and snapshot reads.

The node

  • uc2_node — the process that participates in consensus, replicates the log, and makes it durable.

Core

  • uc2_consensus — the pure-sync safety core: commit ranking, elections, term maps, truncation. The kernels carrying machine-checked proofs.
  • uc2_log — the shared-memory log ring, and the archive agent that makes it durable.
  • uc2_net — reliable UDP with NAK repair, quorum-paced flow control, journal replay sessions.
  • uc_protocol — the canonical wire spec: cnc page layout, frame formats, lock-free rings.

Supporting

  • uc2_crypto — optional authenticated and encrypted node-to-node transport. Off by default.
  • ultima_journal — segmented append journal and atomic StableValues.
  • uc2_sim — the deterministic simulator: virtual time, seeded fault fuzz, nine whole-cluster invariants.
  • uc_lincheck — the WGL linearizability checker, history recorder, and register model.
Rebuilt on every push to main. Documents public items only; the uc2ctl admin CLI and the example crates are excluded.
